newsitem.title: GREECE: HAMBROS FUND MANAGER JOINS GENERAL MUTUAL FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: HAMBROS FUND MANAGER JOINS GENERAL MUTUAL FUNDS.

text.p: Andreas Papaspyrou, general manager of Hambros Hellenic Mutual Funds has joined General Mutual Funds SA, a subsidiary of General Bank as its new general manager.
Papaspyrou, 32, with an MBA from Athens Economics University (ASOEE) also managed Hambros Hellenic's fixed income funds. He was formerly a portfolio manager with Aspis Mutual Funds.

Recently launched General Mutual Funds SA has five billion drachmas in assets under management split in its two funds -- a drachma money market fund and an equity growth fund. It expects to launch additional funds in the near future. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
